```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment = "#>")
library(pannet)
set.seed(1)
```

`pannet` fits neural panel regression models on top of the local `mlp`
package. The wrapper adds panel-aware preprocessing, optional individual and
time effects, and dynamic lag features.

## Gaussian pooled model

```{r}
df <- data.frame(
  id = rep(1:5, each = 4),
  time = rep(1:4, times = 5),
  x1 = rnorm(20),
  x2 = runif(20),
  y = rnorm(20)
)

fit <- pannet(
  y ~ x1 + x2,
  data = df,
  id = id,
  time = time,
  family = "gaussian",
  model = "pooled",
  epochs = 1,
  verbose = FALSE,
  validation = 0.2
)

predict(fit, df)[1:3]
```

## Dynamic prediction

Dynamic fits can use training history when predicting new periods for known
units.

```{r}
fit_dyn <- pannet(
  y ~ x1,
  data = df,
  id = id,
  time = time,
  family = "gaussian",
  model = "dynamic",
  lags = 1,
  epochs = 1,
  verbose = FALSE,
  validation = 0.2
)

new_period <- data.frame(
  id = c(1, 2),
  time = c(5, 5),
  x1 = rnorm(2)
)

predict(fit_dyn, new_period)
```

## Multiclass and fractional outputs

```{r}
df_multi <- data.frame(
  id = rep(1:4, each = 5),
  time = rep(1:5, times = 4),
  x1 = rnorm(20),
  x2 = runif(20),
  y = factor(sample(letters[1:3], 20, TRUE))
)

fit_multi <- pannet(
  y ~ x1 + x2,
  data = df_multi,
  id = id,
  time = time,
  family = "multiclass",
  model = "pooled",
  epochs = 1,
  verbose = FALSE,
  validation = 0.2
)

predict(fit_multi, df_multi, type = "prob")[1:3, ]
```

```{r}
df_frac <- data.frame(
  id = rep(1:4, each = 5),
  time = rep(1:5, times = 4),
  x1 = rnorm(20),
  y = runif(20)
)

fit_frac <- pannet(
  y ~ x1,
  data = df_frac,
  id = id,
  time = time,
  family = "fractional",
  model = "pooled",
  epochs = 1,
  verbose = FALSE,
  validation = 0.2
)

marginal_effects(fit_frac, "x1")
```
